query: "Retrospective 3-year study of laboratory errors at Thai Red Cross Society hospital assessing pre-analytical, analytical, post-analytical phases, and specimen sources using descriptive statistics and six sigma metrics to enhance quality. Focus on error reduction, trends, statistical methods, automation, and reproducibility in healthcare laboratory testing."
